provenance.note: Salem district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope salem-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-salem). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/tn-tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

properties.name: Mettur CEPI area, core zone: outer frame
properties.whatThisIs: A polygon through the 4 boundary reference points the plan prints. It encloses 21.6 sq km; the plan gives 38.5 sq km, so the true boundary reaches beyond this frame.
properties.latestScore: 19.658 on TNPCB's post-monsoon 2025 evaluation (TNPCB score sheet); 19.7 in TNPCB's policy note 2026-27 (p.94)
properties.cepiScore: 71.82 (Air 41.25, Water 19.38, Land 69.38), CPCB's 2017-18 assessment as the plan prints it (plan, p.5)
properties.earlierScore: 66.98 in CPCB's 2009 assessment (Comprehensive Environmental Assessment of Industrial Clusters, Table 8)
properties.unitsInThePlan: 92 units in the CEPI area, 67 red and 25 orange category (plan, p.12)
properties.source: TNPCB, Evaluation of CEPI score and action plan for CEPI area of Mettur, Salem district, January 2020 (TNPCB and CPCB websites)
